issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 10 asks for the number of hiking trails leading to each municipality and to sort the results descending by that count (no limit mentioned). The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe10.sql) applies a LIMIT 5, returning only the top 5 rows. This restricts the result set and contradicts the problem requirement to list (implicitly) all municipalities ordered by count. Students comparing to or learning from the solution may be confused about whether a LIMIT is required and automated checks expecting all rows could disagree with the solution's truncated output.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the LIMIT 5 from solution_repository/aufgabe10.sql so the query returns all municipalities sorted by Anzahl as requested, or alternatively update the problem statement to explicitly ask for the top 5 if that was intended.
